propositions: Add CLI flag `rebar review-plan --retry` that resumes only the latest eligible INDETERMINATE review by reusing checkpointed findings for units with kind success/resumed and re-running only failed/cancelled journal units plus budget-shed units.

Retry eligibility requires latest REVIEW_RESULT sidecar with versioned discovery_journal; refuse before any model call if result is not INDETERMINATE, journal is missing/stale/corrupt/legacy/digest-mismatched, or no retryable units exist, exiting with code 2 and printing full-review remedy.

Each explicit --retry grants fresh per-invocation attempt budget; cumulative lineage spend is stored as audit telemetry and never blocks later retries; verification/coaching/decision/assembly rerun over combined prior+recovered results.
`--retry` is mutually exclusive with `--force`, `--status`, and `--check`; compatible with `--no-sign`; normal review behavior unchanged without flag.

Document retry semantics in review-plan --help, docs/cli-reference.md, docs/user-guide.md, docs/plan-review-gate.md, and docs/exit-codes.md covering eligibility, fresh budget, reuse/refusal behavior, and distinction from --status and sign-review.

Validate with real CLI subprocess test using temporary ticket store and production journal codec; assert exit code, zero-call refusal path, eligible resume path, persisted retry lineage, and final verdict end-to-end.
